inspiration.observed_pattern: DATE_ADD applies multiple interval units to a stored event timestamp in one deterministic projection.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent shipment schedule audit. Each shipment projects a two-week review deadline and a four-hour handoff time from its scheduled timestamp; source names, schema, and rows are not copied.

fixture_notes: Review deadlines use a calendar-week interval while handoff times use an hour interval, exposing both unit paths against fixed DATETIME values.
determinism_notes: All timestamps, interval amounts, IDs, and ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE shipment_schedule (shipment_id INT PRIMARY KEY, scheduled_at DATETIME NOT NULL, route_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT shipment_id, route_code, DATE_ADD(scheduled_at, INTERVAL 2 WEEK) AS review_due, DATE_ADD(scheduled_at, INTERVAL 4 HOUR) AS handoff_at FROM shipment_schedule ORDER BY shipment_id
